description: Server-side, site-visible configuration of the home page's block versions plus the default light/dark mode. One document applies to ALL visitors of a stand (rule: order t-2026-09-09-02, point 1). Field keys and allowed values are the composer's own corridor (artifacts/docs/composer/lib/blocks.js, hero.js, page.js SLOTS).

citations.profileDefaults: artifacts/docs/composer/versions.json (versions tagged "Основная" in their note field)

defaultMode.note: Today baked at build time from theme.defaultMode in apps/backend/.../profile.json and overridden per-browser by localStorage (apps/storefront/src/lib/theme/apply.ts:15-25, attributes.ts:38-41). This field is the operator-set SERVER default that a visitor who has never switched sees; it does not touch the per-browser override, which still wins once a visitor has picked a mode themselves.
